Jordan and Palestine. Children's game related to Crazy Eights: no wild suit card; Aces force another player to give the active player a King ('checkmate'). Red and black Jokers match any card of their colour.
2, 3, or 4 players. Play anticlockwise. If dealer wins, deal passes right; otherwise same player deals again.
52 cards plus 2 Jokers (one red, one black). 54 cards total.
10 cards each, one at a time. Rest form face-down stock (fanned; any card may be drawn). Dealer leads first card to start play pile.
